mapper.select:
select BEAD_CODE, listagg(sm.MACHINE_ID,',') within group (order by sm.MACHINE_ID) as machine_ids from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by BEAD_CODE

select mouth_plate_code, listagg(sm.MACHINE_ID,',') within group (order by sm.MACHINE_ID) as machine_ids from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE sm inner join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0' and sm.status = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by MOUTH_PLATE_CODE
